findings.title: The queued timestamp is shared across all instances
findings.body: `timezone.now()` is evaluated once when this module is imported, so every `AssignmentSource` created in the process gets the same `queued` value rather than the time that source was created. Since `to_dict()` includes this value in outbound task payloads, the serialized assignment context reports an incorrect timestamp for later assignments. Use a `default_factory` so each instance gets its own timestamp.
